questions.content: Câu 1: Choose the sentence which has the closest meaning to the original one. Lucy is excited about meeting her new pen pal from Thailand.
options: A. Lucy can't wait to meet her new pen pal from Thailand.
B. Lucy is waiting to meet her new pen pal from Thailand.
C. Lucy is excited that her new pen pal from Thailand is waiting for her.
D. Lucy can't bear meeting her new pen pal from Thailand.
questions.note: Đáp án đúng: A Giải thích: be excited about (hào hức với việc gì) = can’t wait to (không thể chờ đợi) … Dịch nghĩa: Lucy nóng lòng muốn gặp bạn mới từ Thái Lan.

questions.content: Câu 2: Choose the sentence which has the closest meaning to the original one. Our group managed to deliver a presentation on ASEAN yesterday.
options: A. Our group found a manager to deliver a presentation on ASEAN yesterday.
B. Our group succeeded in delivering a presentation on ASEAN yesterday.
C. A presentation on ASEAN was delivered to the manager of our group yesterday.
D. The delivery of our presentation on ASEAN was managed yesterday.
questions.note: Đáp án đúng: B Giải thích: manage to do sth = succeed in doing sth (thành công trong việc gì). Dịch nghĩa: Nhóm của chúng tôi đã thành công trong việc thuyết trình về ASEAN hôm qua.

questions.content: Câu 3: Choose the sentence which has the closest meaning to the original one. Perhaps Vietnam will defeat Thailand in the football final of the ASEAN game.
options: A. Vietnam must defeat Thailand in the football final of the ASEAN game.
B. Vietnam may probably defeat Thailand in the football final of the ASEAN game.
C. Vietnam should have defeated Thailand in the football final of the ASEAN game.
D. Vietnam can't have defeated Thailand in the football final of the ASEAN game.
questions.note: Đáp án đúng: B Giải thích: Perhaps = may / probably (có thể). Dịch nghĩa: Có lẽ Việt Nam sẽ đánh bại Thái Lan trong trận chung kết bóng đá của ASEAN Games.

questions.content: Câu 4: Choose the sentence which has the closest meaning to the original one. California doesn't permit people to fish without a fishing license.
options: A. California can't stand fishing without a fishing license.
B. California doesn't allow fishing without a fishing license.
C. California doesn't encourage fishing without a fishing license.
D. California doesn't mind fishing without a fishing license.
questions.note: Đáp án đúng: B Giải thích: doesn't permit = doesn't allow (không cho phép). Dịch nghĩa: Ở California, không được phép câu cá nếu không có giấy phép.

questions.content: Câu 5: Choose the sentence which has the closest meaning to the original one. “Why don't we go for a walk?" Mary said.
options: A. Mary advised to go for a walk.
B. Mary asked going for a walk.
C. Mary suggested going for a walk.
D. Mary would like going for a walk.
questions.note: Đáp án đúng: C Giải thích: Cấu trúc gợi ý: Why don’t we …? = suggested + V-ing. Dịch nghĩa: Mary gợi ý đi dạo.

questions.content: Câu 6: Choose the sentence which has the closest meaning to the original one. I regret missing the opening ceremony of the ASEAN GAMES last night.
options: A. I wish I could miss the opening ceremony of the ASEAN GAMES last night.
B. I wish I did not miss opening ceremony of the ASEAN GAMES last night.
C. I wish to miss opening ceremony of the ASEAN GAMES last night.
D. I wish I had not missed opening ceremony of the ASEAN GAMES last night.
questions.note: Đáp án đúng: D Giải thích: Hối tiếc về một việc đã xảy ra → wish + past perfect. Dịch nghĩa: Tôi ước gì mình đã không bỏ lỡ lễ khai mạc SEA Games tối qua.

questions.content: Câu 7: Choose the sentence which has the closest meaning to the original one. I said that she should see a doctor.
options: A. I advised her seeing a doctor.
B. I advised her should see a doctor.
C. I advised her to see a doctor.
D. I advised to see a doctor.
questions.note: Đáp án đúng: C Giải thích: Cấu trúc: advise sb to do sth (khuyên ai đó làm gì). Dịch nghĩa: Tôi khuyên cô ấy nên đi khám bác sĩ.

questions.content: Câu 8: Choose the sentence which has the closest meaning to the original one. Ireland doesn't allow people to smoke in bars.
options: A. Ireland doesn't enjoy smoking in bars.
B. Ireland hates smoking in bars.
C. Smoking in bars is banned in Ireland.
D. You should not smoke in bars in Ireland.
questions.note: Đáp án đúng: C Giải thích: doesn’t allow (không cho phép) = is banned (bị cấm). Dịch nghĩa: Hút thuốc trong quán bar bị cấm ở Ireland.
